task.description: Independently re-verify ISS-0829's fix before it's closed (checkout feature/WF03-ISS0829-20260927, pull to get commit 21208694). Docker Postgres should be healthy. (1) Independently re-run scripts/test_parallel.sh (TEST_PARALLEL_N=4) as a true background process, polled -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. Expect a different failure set than TEST-RUNNER saw; attribute each failure structurally (git diff origin/main...HEAD on the specific failing file) rather than by count-matching. (2) Confirm EO-004 and EO-005 pass and that their new assertions genuinely test tenant/rollout-scoped invariants rather than having been weakened into an always-pass check -- read the actual test code, not just the design doc's claims. (3) TEST-RUNNER flagged two NEW pre-existing failure classes incidentally (Letflow.EventStore.RetentionOperationsTest and Letflow.IdentityTest REQ-019 AC1) -- confirm these are genuinely pre-existing/unrelated to this branch (git diff attribution) and note them for ORCH to file as new issues; do NOT investigate or fix them in this run (per ORCHESTRATOR.md's incidental-finding rule, that would extend scope). (4) Complete the handoff: PASS -> route to ORCH for issue close-out; FAIL -> name the blocking issue and which agent it routes back to.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/test_parallel.sh re-run independently as a true backgrounded+polled process, real aggregated output quoted
Every failure in this independent run attributed structurally, not by count-matching against TEST-RUNNER's report
EO-004/EO-005's actual test code re-read and confirmed to test real invariants, not weakened to always-pass
The two incidentally-found failure classes confirmed pre-existing/unrelated via git diff, and explicitly NOT investigated further in this run
PASS or FAIL verdict with next_action; handoff completed per protocol (claim via IN_PROGRESS, then COMPLETED with a real result block)
